generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time.
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately as per applicable.
All the Work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number
For Confirmation of the lake boundary, a Revenue survey shall be Carried out by the onboarding contractor.

The benches are treated with metal epoxy primer, jet black coating, and nano-coated with clear wooden finish Teak/Rosewood grains.The final finish is between 70 to 90 microns, made to endure corrosion, rust, oxidation, and is also protective against UV damage. The bench is made to withhold a seating capacity of 225 kgs. The benches are composed of 2mm thick 20x40mm pipes for the seat and 20x40mm for the backrest, with 7 pipes for the seat and 6 pipes for the backrest. The hand rest is made of a 20x40mm pipe, positioned 24" from ground level. The base plate is 80x80x6mm, with 4 plates per bench. The armrest will be curved on both ends, measuring 2ft in length each, joining the legs of the bench. Each leg of the bench will have a 4” diameter plate at the base. The grouting will be 6” into the surface. The dimensions of the bench are 6ft in length, 2ft in depth, and 3.6ft in total height, including the backrest. The seat height from the ground is 18”, and the backrest height is 18”. The manufacturer must possess a valid ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) Bronze Certificate
